text:
Iris Novak: dropped a new compact-row mock for Autoscale controls. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/compact-autoscale-ux. Main idea: show Min/Max as a tight readout on narrow widths with an inline chevron to expand to steppers. Also propose a tiny info pill next to the SLO slider that surfaces p95 estimate + cost delta on hover.
Jon Kim: overall looks clean. Concern: the inline pill might push layout in small dashboards. Suggest the pill be hidden by default and revealable via keyboard/focus (e.g., a focusable info button).
Priya Sharma: Accessibility notes: info button must be reachable by keyboard and should open a focus-trapped popover. Use `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded` toggles. The slider needs `aria-labelledby` + `aria-describedby` pointing to the explanatory text.
Leo Martin: Implementation thought: for collapsed Min/Max show `Min 1 · Max 8` with a visible separator. When collapsed and focused, pressing Enter should expand inline. Keep touch targets >=44px.
Iris Novak: Copy idea for burst state: "Burst capacity (short-lived)" on badge; tooltip: "Temporarily uses elastic GPUs for up to X mins; may change cost." Short label for mobile: "Burst (short)".
Jon Kim: Edge case: pinned/dedicated pools should surface a disabled burst state with text: "Burst not supported on pinned pools" and a lock icon. Make sure color isn't the only indicator.
Priya Sharma: For screen readers, don't rely on visual badges. Add an offscreen summary: `Autoscale: min 1, max 8, burst disabled: pinned pool`. Reference it with `aria-describedby` on the entire row.
accessibility-bot: Tip: when estimates update (p95 / cost) use an `aria-live="polite"` region and debounce updates (250ms) to avoid spamming AT. Also ensure live region text is concise.
Leo Martin: UX interactions: when user drags the SLO slider show a small transient chip near the thumb with `~320ms · +8% cost`. Keyboard users should get the same in the offscreen live region.
Iris Novak: Debate: show numeric estimates inline or only on hover. My take: show a compact icon + chevron. Hover/focus opens a small panel with `Est. p95: 320ms · Cost: +8%` and a short explanation. Keeps density low.
Jon Kim: Validation behavior: if user sets values that violate guardrail, show an inline banner: "Guardrail violated: this setting would push P95 above target" with action `Auto-suggest safe value`. Banner should not disappear until acknowledged or corrected.
Priya Sharma: Keyboard flow proposal: tab -> collapsed row chevron -> expand -> min input -> max input -> burst toggle -> SLO slider -> info button. Escape closes popovers and returns to chevron. Ensure focus order remains logical even when the row is collapsed.
Leo Martin: Visual accessibility: use icons + text for burst states; focus rings must meet 3:1 contrast and be at least 3px wide in the theme. For dark theme, tweak the thumb color so the active state remains distinguishable.
Iris Novak: I'll iterate the artboards: collapsed, expanded, pinned-pool (burst disabled), and the popover content with offscreen strings. Will add the `aria-describedby` ids in the spec and a short code snippet for the live region. Tagging @Priya for a11y review and @Jon for copy. ETA: tomorrow morning. :rocket:
